scope_note: This registry records supplied claims and preliminary cross-check notes. It is not a legal opinion, official registry certification, or proof of ownership, adoption, or valuation.

status_definitions.VERIFIED_MATCH: Authoritative primary record located and materially matches the claim.
status_definitions.MISMATCH_FOUND: A located record conflicts with the supplied identifier, title, owner, or claim.
status_definitions.PENDING_DIRECT_LOOKUP: An authoritative record has not yet been established; direct registry lookup remains required.
status_definitions.UNVERIFIED_ASSERTION: Claim has no supporting primary evidence attached to this registry.
status_definitions.UNVERIFIED_VALUATION_ASSERTION: Valuation is preserved as supplied but lacks independently supported methodology and evidence.
status_definitions.UNVERIFIED_LEGAL_ASSERTION: Legal effect has not been established by applicable law and executed documents.
status_definitions.PENDING_SOURCE_LOOKUP: The required official primary source has not yet been checked.
status_definitions.PRIMARY_SOURCE_MATCH: The official primary record was retrieved and the queried identifier and material fields match; source evidence must be attached.
status_definitions.SECONDARY_CORROBORATION: An independent secondary source supports context or corroborates a primary-source finding; it does not alone establish official status.
status_definitions.DISCREPANCY_FOUND: A source conflicts with the submitted identifier, title, owner, date, or other material claim; preserve both claim and evidence.
status_definitions.UNVERIFIED: Available evidence is insufficient to support the claim.
status_definitions.VERIFIED_WITH_SCOPE: Evidence supports only the explicitly documented scope of the claim; source evidence must be attached.

sourcing_policy.rule: Check the relevant official source first. Use independent secondary sources to corroborate context or flag conflicts; secondary reporting alone does not establish legal status when an authoritative register or executed instrument is applicable.

evidence_record_schema.source_url: Exact URL of the record or document
evidence_record_schema.retrieved_at: ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone, or null if not yet retrieved
evidence_record_schema.matched_identifier: Identifier shown by source, or null
evidence_record_schema.excerpt: Short relevant excerpt or field values; do not copy unnecessary personal data

rules: Do not label a claim verified merely because a search result exists; compare the exact identifier and material fields.
A search miss is not proof of nonexistence.
Keep source claims immutable; append evidence and audit events instead of silently replacing submitted claims.
Record retrieval timestamp, query identifier, exact result URL, and material field comparison for every lookup.
Use VERIFIED_WITH_SCOPE only for the specific proposition supported by the evidence.
A secondary source corroborates but does not replace the official record where one is available.
A structurally valid registry is not an independently verified portfolio.
